visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair wearing a black sweater stands before a shelf of makeup brushes, holding one up to his face with a playful expression. (2) A top-down shot reveals a wooden table covered in professional makeup brush rolls and loose tools, showcasing a massive variety of bristle types. (3) The man stands outdoors on a city sidewalk in front of a modern grey building; a Korean flag and a 'Piccasso' sign are visible on the exterior. (4) Inside a building, the camera focuses on an elevator directory sign where a red arrow points to '2 Piccasso SINCE 1990'. (5) Interior of a store featuring giant decorative brushes hanging from the ceiling and walls lined with neatly organized black makeup brushes. (6) Close-up shots of specific products, including a fan brush, a white powder puff, and various angled foundation brushes held in hands. (7) A white tray contains several selected brushes, which are then shown being placed into a large black shopping bag already containing several boxed items. (8) The man holds small silver jars and draws lines on his hand to demonstrate product shades, followed by showing liquid eyeliner pens. (9) Final shot of the man holding a large shopping bag, smiling at the camera before a map graphic with Korean text appears.
